facb6e088809bfe9.description: About the Role Olayan Saudi Holding Company is seeking a Senior Officer Treasury to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role integrates technology, operational expertise, data, and analytics to address constraints that hinder commissioning, stabilization, and early operational performance. It focuses on identifying high-impact opportunities across throughput, recovery, uptime, cost, and production readiness, translating them into practical interventions to accelerate performance improvement. The role provides an enterprise-wide perspective, enabling the reuse of successful approaches across different operations and strengthening the transition from commissioning to reliable operations. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement an enterprise approach to asset ramp-up, aiming to shorten the path from commissioning to stable operations across mining and processing assets. Identify and activate critical levers for throughput, recovery, uptime, cost, and readiness to accelerate early-stage asset performance. Diagnose systemic ramp-up constraints and facilitate targeted interventions to address root causes and protect production value. Translate ramp-up opportunities into measurable value hypotheses, performance targets, and interventions with clear ownership and benefit tracking. Drive sustained improvements in ramp-up speed, asset utilization, and operational readiness through fact-based performance management. Provide actionable insights to leadership for prioritizing interventions and investments based on operational value. Accelerate the application of advanced analytics, digital twins, and predictive capabilities to improve commissioning, stabilization, and ramp-up decisions. Embed relevant digital capabilities into operational workflows to enhance real-time visibility, decision quality, and performance management. Enable repeatable ramp-up use cases to scale across assets in collaboration with technology, data, and solution teams. Orchestrate alignment across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI, projects, and commissioning stakeholders to resolve cross-functional dependencies. Establish consistent governance, performance measures, and executive-level visibility for priority ramp-up initiatives. Strengthen the transition between project, commissioning, and operational teams through clear performance expectations and integrated execution. Develop and embed scalable ramp-up playbooks, tools, and practices suitable for various asset classes and operating environments. Convert lessons learned from asset ramp-ups into reusable organizational knowledge to improve subsequent commissioning and stabilization. Build organizational capability through technical coaching, knowledge transfer, and the adoption of proven ramp-up practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Measures of Success Reduced time from commissioning to stable and targeted operating performance. Improved throughput, recovery, uptime, and asset utilization during ramp-up phases. Measurable value realized from prioritized digital, analytics, and operational interventions. Reduced recurrence of ramp-up constraints through effective root-cause resolution and the reuse of lessons learned. Increased adoption of standardized ramp-up methods, playbooks, and proven use cases across applicable assets. Stronger visibility of ramp-up performance, risks, and value realization to enable faster management decisions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

fa37623c1555528e.description: About the Role Akkodis is seeking an Oracle Cloud Architect/Engineer for a 2-month freelance assignment based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is scheduled to commence on November 1, 2026. The successful consultant must currently reside in Saudi Arabia and will be responsible for implementing and securing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments. Key Responsibilities The primary responsibility of this position is to implement and secure Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments. This includes a range of duties focused on security, identity, data protection, and resilience. Specific Duties Implement OCI Security Zones and configure Cloud Guard (CSPM). Perform landing-zone hardening for the sovereign realm. Implement and manage IAM/PAM solutions, configure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and enforce least-privilege and Just-In-Time (JIT) access models. Implement and enforce Operator Access Control (OAC) workflows. Configure and manage OCI Vault, implement HSM-based key management (FIPS 140-2 Level 3), and manage customer-managed encryption keys and BYOK solutions, ensuring alignment with NCS-1:2020 cryptographic standards. Design and secure OCI VCN and NSG environments, implement private-only endpoints, configure FastConnect connectivity, and deploy and manage WAF and DDoS protection controls. Implement OCI Data Safe capabilities, including data discovery, data masking, and activity auditing, while enforcing data residency requirements. Configure immutable audit logging, implement log ingestion and monitoring capabilities, integrate OCI telemetry and logs with SIEM platforms, and provide control telemetry and evidence collection mechanisms.
